title: IBM Watson wins the Jeopardy! challenge
summary: IBM's Watson question-answering system defeated Jeopardy! champions Ken Jennings and Brad Rutter in a televised contest conducted over February 14–16, 2011. IBM's retrospective records Watson's final winning score as USD 77,147, ahead of Jennings and Rutter.
significance: A documented natural-language question-answering milestone in which IBM Watson competed successfully against leading human Jeopardy! champions.

verification.note: IBM's official Watson history states that Watson defeated Ken Jennings and Brad Rutter in the televised February 2011 Jeopardy! contest and records the final scores. IBM's January 31, 2011 announcement explicitly schedules Watson's contest against the two champions for February 14–16, 2011. The candidate therefore uses February 16, 2011 as the documented completion date of the winning contest, not as a system-birth date. No geography, ancestry, influence, or causality is inferred.

sources.title: IBM Watson to Compete Against Jeopardy! Champions February 14–16, 2011
